grip.note: Staff shaft through the closed right fist, in the RightHand bone frame; measured on the skinned hand in the idle pose.

idle.title: Idle
idle.adaptation: Target proportions, sole grounding, relaxed left hand; right arm replaced by an authored staff hold

walk.title: Walking
walk.adaptation: Travel removed from the hips, sole grounding, relaxed left hand; right arm replaced by an authored staff hold that sways with the stride

measured.metersPerCycleFrom: backward speed of the planted arch under the body

jog.description: Procedural jog for the traveler rig: 36% duty factor with two flight phases, knee ~40° loaded / ~100° in swing (folded further where needed to clear the ground on this skeleton), elbows ~85°, free arm ±30°, trunk lean ~9°; staff arm steadied

measured.metersPerCycleFrom: backward speed of the flat, loaded foot under the body
